policy.absence: No shared form in sampled entries is not proof of absence in the language; missing usable accepted forms remain unknown
policy.identity: Unicode NFC and whitespace normalization only. Preserve supplied IPA or explicitly stressed source citations when available; otherwise use labelled normalized segments. Upstream normalization may already omit stress or other contrasts; no absent information is reconstructed.

kinds.inferred: Guarded explicit disjunctive-concept expansion; never counted as an independently elicited pair
kinds.observed: Reported whole-form identities across distinct mapped source records; semantic and replication eligibility are separately assessed, never inferred from correct pronunciation.

layers.reduced: Exact ASJP/GLED-derived segment identity; omitted contrasts cannot be reconstructed
layers.segmented: Exact supplied IPA, explicitly stressed source citation, or source/profile normalized segment sequences, kept in separate comparison scopes. Normalized segments may already omit prosody; equality is evidence of identity as represented, not certification of complete phonetic equivalence.
layers.written: Exact case-sensitive stored Form identity (source spelling or normalized citation); not independent phonetic evidence. Known ASJP-derived sources excluded.

policy.partial_colexification: Not inferred by substring matching: shared morphology and chance overlap require a separately validated method

robustness.backbone: At least two known eligible families and positive support after any one resource-block removal; all raw rare associations remain available.
robustness.calibration: No statistical-significance claim: a scope-, degree-, provenance- and availability-aware validated null is not established by a recurrence cutoff or resampling frequency.
robustness.clustering: Weighted replicated backbone, medoid of ten seeded Infomap partitions; raw/regularized/Leiden/source/area/family-block sensitivity, no p-value or semantic-truth interpretation.
robustness.projection: Each k-concept identity contributes 2/(k*(k-1)) per pair; maxima collapse sources/lects/synonyms within each known family.
robustness.resource_deletion: Sum family maxima after removal of each known resource block; use the smallest sum. Blocks are not asserted independent original sources.
robustness.semantic_gate: English Wiktionary headword-only mappings are unreviewed until explicit shared, parameter or native-record sense review matches the accepted concept.

policy.source_dependence: Distinct varieties, Glottolog language units and known family lineages are counted separately; source attestations are not independent confirmations
